## Summary

Work is on branch `fix/game-config-envkey-audit` in the isolated worktree `/opt/nxeon-staging-envkeyfix` (7 commits ahead of `main`, not pushed, not deployed). Full typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`, whole project) and the relevant test suites (`test/game-variant.test.ts`, `test/games.test.ts` — 32 tests) pass clean.

**Method:** For every family I pulled the live production `OsTemplate.setupScript` directly from the prod DB (read-only `psql` against `nxeon`) and diffed each schema field's `key`/`envKey` against the literal `-e FLAG=` strings actually present in that script — the same mechanism `applyGameConfigEnv` in `worker/game-variant.ts` uses. This caught cases where a field's own `help` text already claimed the "real env var" but `envKey` was simply never set (exactly the V Rising bug class), including one the family's own top-comment got wrong (`unturned`).

**Fixed (6 families, real envKey mismatches, in `lib/game-config.ts`):**
- **conan**: `serverName`→`GAME_SERVER_NAME`, `serverPassword`→`GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD`
- **unturned**: `serverName`→`SERVER_NAME`, `serverType`→`SERVER_TYPE` (its own top-comment wrongly called these file-based)
- **sunkenland**: `worldGuid`→`GAME_WORLD_GUID` — this is the family's one `required: true` field
- **corekeeper**: `worldName`→`WORLD_NAME`, `maxPlayers`→`MAX_PLAYERS`
- **arkasa**: `SessionName`→`SESSION_NAME`, `ServerPassword`→`SERVER_PASSWORD`, `AdminPassword`→`SERVER_ADMIN_PASSWORD` (the last one fixes a hardcoded-`changeme12`-for-every-server bug, same class as V Rising's password)
- **sandstorm**: `serverName`→`HOSTNAME` (its top-comment claimed a composed `LAUNCH_SERVER_ENV` mechanism that isn't actually what the live script does)

Each got its own commit explaining the exact mismatch, citing the live script.

**Audited, no code fix possible (13 families)** — documented directly in the file so this isn't mistaken for an unaudited gap later: `sdtd`, `gmod`, `sonsoftheforest`, `terraria`, `theisle`, `eco`, `empyrion` (comments already accurate — genuinely file-based/composed/entrypoint-overridden); `theforest` (corrected a comment that claimed a `SERVER_SETTINGS_MODE=auto` env-injection mechanism that the live script doesn't actually use — nothing in this family reaches the container today); `vintagestory` (had zero explanatory comment despite being fully unwired — added one); `dragonwilds`, `dst`, `tf2`, `nightingale` (each has some fields whose bare key already matches the real flag — confirmed correct, no change — and some fields with no matching flag at all, now documented).

**Live verification: not completed this session.** I set up to do it exactly like the V Rising reference (real `placeGameOrder` order flow against `/opt/nxeon-staging`'s separate `nxeon_staging` DB and its running `nxeon-staging-worker`), but the sandbox's own permission classifier blocked writing a test User/Server/Job into that database as "Modify Shared Resources" — that tree currently carries unrelated in-progress work (`promo-trial-798`, 18 commits ahead). I did not try to route around it. I first mistakenly wrote a "verified end-to-end" claim into the Unturned commit before actually testing — caught it and amended that commit to state plainly it wasn't verified. I also restored `/opt/nxeon-staging/lib/game-config.ts` to its exact original content and restarted its worker, so that shared tree is untouched. No test VMs were created this session (the block happened before any provisioning could start), so there's nothing to clean up.

All 6 fixes are grounded in a direct string comparison against the real, live `OsTemplate.setupScript` — solid evidence, same source of truth the V Rising fix used — but none were confirmed against an actual running container's `docker inspect` output this session.

**If you want live confirmation:** either grant a one-time permission for DB writes to `nxeon_staging` (fastest — the order script is already written and tested for read access, at `/tmp/.../scratchpad/place-order.ts`), or I can build a fully isolated throwaway test database from scratch next session (avoids the shared-resource concern entirely, but is more setup work).

Relevant paths: `/opt/nxeon-staging-envkeyfix/lib/game-config.ts` (all edits), branch `fix/game-config-envkey-audit` off `main` in `/opt/nxeon`.

result: Audited all 19 listed game families' config schemas against their live production setup scripts; fixed real envKey mismatches in conan, unturned, sunkenland, corekeeper, arkasa, and sandstorm (6 commits), documented the other 13 as correctly-unwired or already-correct (1 commit) — all on unpushed branch `fix/game-config-envkey-audit`, typecheck and tests green, but live container verification wasn't completed because the sandbox blocked writes to the shared staging DB.
